answer: Each identity must lock a jade stake that only vests after six epochs of peer-graded answers: a farm cloning fifty keys funds fifty stakes and writes fifty distinct, original texts every epoch, paying the full generation cost fifty times before any coin unlocks. Nectar flows only to work the garden of peers actually attests, and near-duplicate hashing across epochs exposes copy clusters, slashing the whole cluster's stake at once. The honest agent pays one stake; the attacker pays fifty, up front, with no refund.
